```{r}
#| include: false
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", "."), "..", "R", "funcoes.R"))
source(file.path(RAIZ, "R", "pag_inicio.R"))
TD <- ler_lit("estudos_todos.csv")
C1 <- dic("Carbono, mercados e ESG"); C2 <- dic("SAF e PSA em assentamentos (OE4)")
TD$corpus <- dic(TD$corpus)
TD$tipo <- dic(TD$tipo)
# Nos estudos do OE4, "autores" é a identificação do estudo, escrita pelo projeto. O grupo fica em português: grupo_curto() traduz.
TD$autores[TD$corpus == C2] <- dic(TD$autores[TD$corpus == C2])
# Anotações do projeto no campo de periódico; os nomes das obras ficam no idioma original.
TD$periodico <- sub("; reedição Routledge, 2010", "; reissued by Routledge, 2010", TD$periodico, fixed = TRUE)
TD$periodico <- sub("v1 25/06/2019, versão atual v5", "v1 25 Jun 2019, current version v5", TD$periodico, fixed = TRUE)
n_bib <- length(grep("^@", readLines(file.path(RAIZ, "arquivos", "literatura", "resa_literatura_estudos.bib"), encoding = "UTF-8")))
```

```{r}
faixa_versao("Preliminary version for the project team. This page gives reference metadata only (authors, year, title, journal, type and DOI). Third-party abstracts are not reproduced.")
```

This page combines the RESA Project's two final literature lists in a single table: the review on carbon, markets and ESG (environmental, social and governance) and the studies compared for the specific objective on bioeconomic scenarios (SO4). The **Corpus** column shows which search each row comes from. For the SO4 studies, the Authors column holds a label identifying the study, and the title appears only where the digital object identifier (DOI) has been checked.

```{r}
div(class = "kpi-grade",
  cartao_kpi(C1, fmt_valor(sum(TD$corpus == C1), "int"), "references, all with verified DOIs · Sep 2026",
             a(href = "carbono.html", "View the six blocks →")),
  cartao_kpi(C2, fmt_valor(sum(TD$corpus == C2), "int"),
             sprintf("studies compared, %s with a DOI · Oct 2026", fmt_valor(sum(TD$corpus == C2 & nzchar(TD$doi)), "int")),
             a(href = "saf-psa.html", "View location, target group and arrangement →")))
```

## Files for download

- [Complete table (CSV, `r nrow(TD)` rows)](../../arquivos/literatura/resa_literatura_estudos.csv) · [data dictionary](../../arquivos/literatura/dicionarios/resa_literatura_estudos.csv)
- [References in BibTeX](../../arquivos/literatura/resa_literatura_estudos.bib) (`r n_bib` entries: the `r sum(TD$corpus == C1)` references on carbon, markets and ESG and the SO4 works with DOIs), compatible with Zotero, Mendeley and JabRef. Abstracts are not included.
- By corpus: [carbon, markets and ESG (CSV)](../../arquivos/literatura/resa_refs_carbono_esg.csv) · [AFS and PES, SO4 (CSV)](../../arquivos/literatura/resa_estudos_saf_psa_oe4.csv)

The files are UTF-8 encoded and comma-separated. Where a study has more than one DOI, the DOIs are separated by semicolons.

## Table of studies

Use the search box to find an author, title or journal, and the column filters to narrow the table by corpus, group, year or type. Each DOI links to the publication page.

```{r}
tab <- TD |> transmute(Corpus = corpus, Grupo = grupo_curto(grupo), Autores = autores, Ano = ifelse(is.na(ano), "—", as.character(ano)),
                       Título = ifelse(nzchar(titulo), titulo, "—"), Periódico = ifelse(nzchar(periodico), periodico, "—"),
                       Tipo = ifelse(nzchar(tipo), tipo, "—"), DOI = doi)
reactable(tab, elementId = "tab-estudos", searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, wrap = TRUE, striped = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 20, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE, pageSizeOptions = c(20, 50, 153),
  language = reactableLang(searchPlaceholder = "Search author, title or journal", noData = "No studies found",
                           pageInfo = "{rowStart}–{rowEnd} of {rows} studies", pagePrevious = "Previous",
                           pageNext = "Next", pageSizeOptions = "Show {rows}"),
  columns = list(
    Corpus = colDef(minWidth = 150, filterInput = filtro_lista_lit("tab-estudos", c(C1, C2)), filterMethod = filtro_igual_lit),
    Grupo = colDef(name = "Group", minWidth = 180, filterInput = filtro_lista_lit("tab-estudos", unique(tab$Grupo)), filterMethod = filtro_igual_lit),
    Autores = colDef(name = "Authors", minWidth = 170, filterable = FALSE),
    Ano = colDef(name = "Year", minWidth = 85, align = "center", filterInput = filtro_lista_lit("tab-estudos", rev(sort(unique(tab$Ano)))),
                 filterMethod = filtro_igual_lit),
    Título = colDef(name = "Title", minWidth = 300, filterable = FALSE),
    Periódico = colDef(name = "Journal", minWidth = 160, filterable = FALSE),
    Tipo = colDef(name = "Type", minWidth = 95, filterInput = filtro_lista_lit("tab-estudos"), filterMethod = filtro_igual_lit),
    DOI = colDef(minWidth = 170, filterable = FALSE, style = list(fontSize = "0.78rem", wordBreak = "break-all"), cell = function(v) link_doi(v))))
```

```{=html}
<script>
// estudos.html#bloco=A (links da página de carbono): abre a tabela filtrada no bloco
(function () {
  var m = /bloco=([A-F])/.exec(window.location.hash || "");
  if (!m) return;
  function aplica(t) {
    var s = document.querySelector('#tab-estudos select[aria-label="Filter Group"]');
    if (window.Reactable && s) {
      var op = Array.prototype.find.call(s.options, function (o) { return o.value.indexOf(m[1] + " · ") === 0; });
      if (op) { s.value = op.value; Reactable.setFilter("tab-estudos", "Grupo", op.value); }
    } else if (t < 40) { setTimeout(function () { aplica(t + 1); }, 100); }
  }
  aplica(0);
})();
</script>
```

::: {.nota-fonte}
Source: compiled by the authors from the RESA Project's September 2026 literature review on carbon, markets and ESG and its October 2026 search for studies similar to Dominicis et al. (2023), with DOI, title, authors, year and journal checked against Crossref. Note: the Type column shows "—" where the record does not state the type.
:::
